notes: REF-BM-02: metadata-service collects title, description and favicon only; no og:image/preview image is parsed or stored (no field in schema). REF-BM-10: /api/tags endpoint exists but no component consumes it — tag inputs in bookmark-editor/collection-controls are plain text fields with no datalist/autocomplete, so no suggestions are offered. REF-BM-14: tag search is implemented via `tag:` syntax in the lexer, not the required `#tag` syntax; `#article` would be treated as a plain full-text word. REF-BM-21: bulk actions operate only on explicitly selected ids; 'Select all visible' is capped at 100 and there is no pagination or filter-scoped 'select all matching', so it cannot apply to a whole filtered collection exceeding the visible set. REF-BM-24: no snapshot capability (no HTML archiving, no PDF handling) anywhere in code or schema. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive/Wayback integration. REF-BM-29: no bundle/saved-filter entity, storage, or UI. REF-BM-30: no Netscape HTML import. REF-BM-31: no Netscape HTML export. REF-BM-32: no user settings entity or preferences UI (default sort/items-per-page/font size not adjustable).
